prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right choice depends on your goals, industry, budget, and preferred services. I can help you find the best fit. A quick way to proceed:

1) Quick questions so I can tailor recommendations
- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, ecommerce sales, content, PR, etc.)
- Which services do you need? (strategy, creative, web, SEO, PPC, social, email, events, B2B sales enablement, etc.)
- What’s your industry? (healthcare, tech, professional services, retail, nonprofit…)
- Approximate annual marketing budget or monthly retainer range?
- Do you prefer a local agency (in Maryland) or are remote/national teams OK?
- Timeline for starting and for seeing results?

2) How I can help once you answer
- Provide a short, curated shortlist of 4–6 Maryland agencies matched to your needs (with one-line reasons and recent relevant work to look at).
- Compare top 3 choices on fit, pricing ballpark, and questions to ask them on discovery calls.
- Draft an outreach/email template to initiate contact and request case studies and references.

3) Quick checklist to evaluate any agency yourself
- Relevant case studies and measurable results
- Clear strategy and process (not just tactics)
- Industry experience and client references
- Team experience and account management structure
- Transparency on pricing, reporting, and KPIs
- Tools/technology they use and integrations with your systems
- Cultural fit and communication style

Tell me the answers to the quick questions above (or which part you want me to do first) and I’ll put together recommendations.
